questions.question: How many connections does the atom 19 have?
questions.evidence: connections refers to bond_id; atom 19 refers to atom_id like 'TR%_19';
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T.bond_id) FROM connected AS T WHERE SUBSTR(T.atom_id, -2) = '19'

questions.question: Find the triple-bonded molecules which are carcinogenic.
questions.evidence: triple-bonded molecules refers to bond_type = '#'; carcinogenic refers to label = '+'
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T2.label = '+'

questions.question: What are the elements of the toxicology and label of molecule TR060?
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element, T2.label FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR060'

questions.question: What is the percentage of carbon in double-bond molecules?
questions.evidence: carbon refers to element = 'c'; double-bond molecules refers to bond_type = '='; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'c'), COUNT(atom_id))
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '='

questions.question: What elements are in the TR004_8_9 bond atoms?
questions.evidence: TR004_8_9 bond atoms refers to bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

questions.question: How many bonds which involved atom 12 does molecule TR009 have?
questions.evidence: TR009 is the molecule id;  involved atom 12 refers to atom_id = 'TR009_12' or atom_id2 = 'TR009_12'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T2.bond_id) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR009' AND T2.atom_id = T1.molecule_id || '_1' OR T2.atom_id2 = T1.molecule_id || '_2'

questions.question: Tally the toxicology element of the 4th atom of each molecule that was carcinogenic.
questions.evidence: label = '+' means molecules are carcinogenic; 4th atom of each molecule refers to substr(atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+' AND SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, -1) = '4' AND LENGTH(T1.atom_id) = 7

questions.question: Is the molecule with the most double bonds carcinogenic?
questions.evidence: double bond refers to bond_type = ' = '; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT T.molecule_id, COUNT(T.bond_type) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY T.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T.bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

questions.question: Which non-carcinogenic molecules consisted more than 5 atoms?
questions.evidence: label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic; molecules consisted more than 5 atoms refers to COUNT(molecule_id) > 5
questions.SQL: SELECT T.molecule_id FROM ( SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T2.atom_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '-' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 5 ) t

questions.question: What elements are in a double type bond?
questions.evidence: double type bond refers to bond_type = '=';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '='

questions.question: Which bond type accounted for the majority of the bonds found in molecule TR010 and state whether or not this molecule is carcinogenic?
questions.evidence: TR010 is the molecule id; majority of the bond found refers to MAX(COUNT(bond_type));
questions.SQL: SELECT T.bond_type FROM ( SELECT T1.bond_type, COUNT(T1.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T1  WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY T1.bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(T1.molecule_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T

questions.question: On average how many carcinogenic molecules are single bonded?
questions.evidence: carcinogenic molecules refers to label = '+'; single-bonded refers to bond_type = '-'; average = DIVIDE(SUM(bond_type = '-'), COUNT(atom_id))
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) AS single_bond_count FROM bond AS T1  INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T3.label = '+' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id) AS subquery

questions.question: List all the elements of atoms that can not bond with any other atoms.
questions.evidence: atoms cannot bond with other atoms means atom_id NOT in connected table;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.element NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id )

questions.question: What is the percentage of double bonds in the molecule TR008? Please provide your answer as a percentage with five decimal places.
questions.evidence: double bond refers to bond_type = '='; TR008 is the molecule id; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(bond_type = '='), COUNT(bond_id)) as percent where molecule_id = 'TR008'
questions.SQL: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.bond_type = '=' THEN T.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.bond_id),5) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR008'
